create_Keypoints_from_tensor: create a Keypoints object from a PyTorch tensor of shape (N, K, 3) with x, y, and visibility
convert_keypoints_to_heatmap: convert keypoint annotations to a heatmap of one-hot labels for Mask R-CNN training
extract_keypoints_from_heatmaps: extract predicted keypoint locations from heatmaps using heatmaps_to_keypoints with bicubic interpolation
index_keypoints_by_slice: index a Keypoints object by integer, slice, or boolean tensor to select specific instances
move_keypoints_to_device: move a Keypoints tensor to a different device using the to method
